entries.speaker: Dietman Matsushita
entries.en: Kuramoto's been in and out of[n]the hospital. I hear he's not going[n]to run in the upcoming election.

entries.speaker: Yoshida
entries.en: I see...

entries.speaker: Dietman Matsushita
entries.en: He plans for his grandson, who's[n]also in our party, to take his place...

entries.speaker: Yoshida
entries.en: Unfortunately, this is all beyond[n]me now...

entries.speaker: Dietman Matsushita
entries.en: Yoshida...

entries.speaker: Dietman Matsushita
entries.en: Hey, you have to keep eating.[n]You're still growing, you know!

entries.speaker: Dietman Matsushita
entries.en: I invited you along because[n]I wanted to ask you something.

entries.speaker: Dietman Matsushita
entries.en: ...What do you think about[n]the Phantom Thieves?

entries.speaker: Dietman Matsushita
entries.en: You've heard of them, right? They've[n]become quite popular as of late...

entries.speaker: Dietman Matsushita
entries.en: I'd like to hear your honest[n]opinion. As a young man,[n]are you for or against them?
I'm for them.
I'm against them.
I don't really care.[clr 27]

entries.speaker: Yoshida
entries.en: You have a very adaptable way of[n]thinking.

entries.speaker: Yoshida
entries.en: Most people who want to get into[n]politics are jealous of them.

entries.speaker: Yoshida
entries.en: Interesting. I didn't expect[n]that. I've heard that the younger[n]generation considers them heroes.

entries.speaker: Yoshida
entries.en: So you follow your own path,[n]without being influenced by[n]public opinion, huh?

entries.speaker: Dietman Matsushita
entries.en: What about you?

entries.speaker: Yoshida
entries.en: However they manage to change[n]hearts, I respect their belief in[n]crushing evil and saving the weak.

entries.speaker: Dietman Matsushita
entries.en: Isn't that similar to what you advocate?

entries.speaker: Yoshida
entries.en: I can't deny that. But that's[n]not why I support them...

entries.speaker: Yoshida
entries.en: I bet they're a group of young people.

entries.speaker: Yoshida
entries.en: Young people who have experienced[n]cruelty and injustice...

entries.speaker: Yoshida
entries.en: They bravely face the societal ills that[n]plague our world without thinking of[n]the consequences.

entries.speaker: Yoshida
entries.en: Brave, yet pitiful... I suppose.

entries.speaker: Dietman Matsushita
entries.en: So the former Diet member who was[n]disgraced by scandals is going to[n]side with them, huh?

entries.speaker: Yoshida
entries.en: ...Is this what you asked me here to[n]speak to me about?

entries.speaker: Dietman Matsushita
entries.en: No... The party has decided which[n]candidates it will back in the various[n]electoral zones.

entries.speaker: Yoshida
entries.en: And...?

entries.speaker: Dietman Matsushita
entries.en: One of our main candidates will[n]represent this area, according to[n]the party's election strategy.

entries.speaker: Dietman Matsushita
entries.en: You have no chance of winning.

entries.speaker: Yoshida
entries.en: ...So you're saying that I should[n]give up my campaign to become[n]a Diet member?

entries.speaker: Dietman Matsushita
entries.en: I won't beat around the bush.[n]Drop out of the election, and[n]become my right-hand man.

entries.speaker: Dietman Matsushita
entries.en: It won't be for naught. I'll put in[n]a motion to have you reinstated[n]as a party member.

entries.speaker: Dietman Matsushita
entries.en: And I will perform an extensive[n]investigation into your expense[n]misappropriation accusations.

entries.speaker: Yoshida
entries.en: Matsushita...

entries.speaker: Dietman Matsushita
entries.en: You'd finally be able to clear[n]your name. Think about it.

entries.speaker: Dietman Matsushita
entries.en: I'll see you again soon, Mr. Secretary.

entries.speaker: Yoshida
entries.en: He likely has an ulterior motive.[n]If he felt hopeful, he wouldn't[n]ask me to not run for the Diet.

entries.speaker: Yoshida
entries.en: I expect he's trying to take advantage[n]of me... That happens a lot in this world.

entries.speaker: Yoshida
entries.en: What would you do at a time[n]like this, [lName]-kun?
I'd decline.[clr 27]
I'd take the offer.
I'd leave it to chance.

entries.speaker: Yoshida
entries.en: So you're telling me to take control of[n]my destiny, hm? You're very inspiring.

entries.speaker: Yoshida
entries.en: It would be nice to finally[n]clear my name. However...

entries.speaker: Yoshida
entries.en: Haha! That's a very philosophical[n]approach.

entries.speaker: Yoshida
entries.en: It's hard to believe that you're so young.

entries.speaker: Yoshida
entries.en: ...Thank you for telling me your[n]honest opinion. Don't worry.[n]I won't stop giving speeches.

entries.speaker: Yoshida
entries.en: Above all, I wish to continue[n]speaking with you.

entries.speaker: Yoshida
entries.en: You have such a fresh outlook on[n]the world.
I feel like my bond with[n]Yoshida is growing deeper...

entries.speaker: Yoshida
entries.en: Let's finish up for today.[n]Sorry I made you tag along.

entries.speaker: Yoshida
entries.en: I'll see you again soon.
